name: ffrwd/blitz
description: An HTML/CSS video compositor: a static HTML document with the video inputs as images, driven over time by change rows, rendered by Blitz (Stylo, Taffy, Parley, Vello CPU) in the wasm sidecar.
test: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --target wasm32-wasip2 --release --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test -p blitz-compose-core -p compose
